_notes:
ams AS7341 11-channel spectral sensor (eight visible bands F1-F8 - 415, 445, 480, 515, 555, 590, 630 and 680 nm - clear, near IR and flicker) at 0x39 (fixed). 8-bit registers. Its six ADCs are connected to the photodiodes through a switch matrix (SMUX), so the ten channels are measured in two halves
Detection: ID (0x92) bits 7:2 = 001001 (0x24), as Adafruit's library checks it. The APDS-9960 is also at 0x39 with its ID at 0x92 (0xAB), so each record's detection fails on the other
Init: ENABLE (0x80) = 0x01 - power on; ATIME (0x81) = 29 and ASTEP (0xCA-0xCB) = 599 - (29 + 1) x (599 + 1) x 2.78 us = 50 ms integration, up to 18000 counts; CFG1 (0xAA) = 0x07 - gain 64x
Poll (500 ms), each half: spectral measurement off (ENABLE = 0x01), SMUX command write (CFG6 0xAF = 0x10), the 20 SMUX configuration bytes (0x00-0x13), SMUX enable (ENABLE = 0x11) and 5 ms for it to finish, measurement on (ENABLE = 0x03) and 120 ms for the 50 ms integration (the first measurement after measurement is turned on also includes the auto-zero, AZ_CONFIG 0xD6: with 60 ms the channels read 0), then ASTATUS and the six channels CH0-CH5 (0x94-0xA0; reading ASTATUS first latches the channels). The first half connects F1, F2, F3, F4, clear and NIR; the second F5, F6, F7, F8, clear and NIR; then measurement is turned off. The pauses split the poll without holding the bus. Channels are raw counts (basic counts are count / (gain x integration time); converting to irradiance needs ams's calibration). saturated is 1 if ASTATUS ASAT (bit 7) is set in either half - lower the gain
Not used: flicker detection, the LED driver, the GPIO and interrupts
Source: the SMUX configurations, the measurement sequence and the ID check are from Adafruit's AS7341 library (https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_AS7341, setup_F1F4_Clear_NIR, setup_F5F8_Clear_NIR, readAllChannels), BSD-3-Clause; see RaftCore's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for its notice. Registers from the ams AS7341 datasheet

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-26, polling paused): the lone 0x99 moves the register pointer, and the read returns channel data registers (0x99-0xA0, reading them doesn't clear anything; ASTATUS, which latches them, isn't read). ENABLE, ATIME, WTIME, CFG0-CFG6 (0xA9-0xAF), ASTEP, AZ_CONFIG and ID unchanged; measurements the same afterwards. Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
